subject.title: config: use datetime suffix for config backup files instead of numeric rotation

question: Should OpenClaw proceed with adjacent timestamped config backups once legacy `.bak.N` files are preserved or converted, or should this wait for the broader dedicated backup-directory design?
rationale: The code repair is concrete, but choosing the permanent backup layout and legacy recovery behavior changes a shipped config recovery contract, so automation should not decide that product boundary alone.

options.title: Proceed With Migration-Safe Timestamp PR
options.body: Require this PR or a replacement to preserve or convert existing numbered backups, add collision fallback, update docs/tests, and prove a real upgrade before merge.

options.title: Fold Into Dedicated Backup Directory
options.body: Close or pause this PR and handle timestamp naming together with the broader dedicated `config-backup/` layout request.

options.title: Keep Numbered Ring
options.body: Reject the timestamp naming change for now and document the numbered backup ring as the intended stable behavior.

recommendation.title: Proceed With Migration-Safe Timestamp PR
recommendation.body: Require this PR or a replacement to preserve or convert existing numbered backups, add collision fallback, update docs/tests, and prove a real upgrade before merge.
